attempts.cause: The checker was mounted at /probe.py without PYTHONPATH=/app. Python used the script directory / as sys.path[0], so the baked /app/src package was not importable.
attempts.correctiveAction: Reran the same network-none/read-only probe with PYTHONPATH=/app.

attempts.cause: The Docker volume option was accidentally placed after the image name and was passed to Python's py_compile module as a program argument.
attempts.correctiveAction: Discarded this malformed auxiliary invocation. Successful execution of the checker itself provides the relevant syntax/import validation.

attempts.causeForSupersession: The app emitted its import-time CORS diagnostic to stdout before the JSON document, so the captured file was not parseable as standalone JSON.
attempts.correctiveAction: Redirected import-time application stdout to stderr inside the checker; no route assertions changed.
